title: OS-Bench: Evaluating SWE Agents on Cross-OS Code Migration
abstract: arXiv:2610.19368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model (LM) agents are increasingly evaluated on repository-level software engineering (SWE) benchmarks derived from GitHub issues and pull requests. Although these benchmarks cover a broad range of development tasks, they provide limited insight into a common yet technically distinct challenge: migrating an existing implementation from one operating system (OS) to another while preserving behavior on both. We introduce OS-Bench, an executable benchmark for cross-OS code migration between Linux and Windows. Motivated by case studies showing that cross-platform features are frequently implemented on one OS before support is added for another, OS-Bench identifies migration opportunities by comparing execution coverage collected from the same repository on both systems. translated_title: OS-Bench：在跨操作系统代码迁移任务上评估软件工程智能体
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19368v1 公告类型：新 摘要：语言模型（LM）智能体越来越多地在基于GitHub议题（issue）和拉取请求（pull request）构建的仓库级软件工程（SWE）基准上进行评估。尽管这些基准涵盖了广泛的开发任务，但对于一个常见而在技术上却截然不同的挑战，它们所能提供的洞察有限：即将现有实现从一个操作系统（OS）迁移到另一个操作系统，同时保持其在两个系统上的行为一致。我们提出了OS-Bench，一个用于Linux与Windows之间跨操作系统代码迁移的可执行基准。受案例研究的启发——这些研究表明跨平台功能通常先在一个操作系统上实现，之后才为另一系统添加支持——OS-Bench通过比较同一仓库在两个系统上收集的执行覆盖率来识别迁移机会。随后，平台特定代码区域经过验证，被归纳为五种迁移场景，并转化为带有目标平台测试和源（摘要在此处被截断）的仓库级任务。
tldr: 提出OS-Bench——首个通过对比同一代码库在Linux与Windows上的执行覆盖率来识别迁移机会，并将平台特定代码组织为五种场景的可执行基准，用于评估语言模型智能体在跨操作系统代码迁移上的能力。
en_tdlr: OS-Bench is an executable benchmark that evaluates LM-based SWE agents on cross-OS code migration between Linux and Windows, identifying migration opportunities by comparing execution coverage of the same repository on both systems and organizing platform-specific code into five repository-level migration scenarios.
